description: This file is a shell script used for preparing UBI devices and volumes for OpenWrt installation, specifically for Buffalo devices. It contains functions to attach UBI devices, remove and re-create UBI volumes, and update firmware hashes.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares UBI devices by removing specific volumes, handling errors, and reattaching devices.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_optvol
methods.description: Re-creates the 'ubi_rootfs' volume, updates 'fw_hash' volumes for rootfs and rootfs_recover, and writes a dummy hash.
